args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4 (and 3.0.x); fixed in 2.9.4.
Staying on the 2.x minor line to limit the upgrade surface.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected: <2.9.4 (and 3.0.x); fixed in 2.9.4. Staying on the 2.x line to limit upgrade surface.

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.
